# Vendored stroke assets

- **hanzi-writer.min.js** — Hanzi Writer 3.7.1, MIT. https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer
- **hanzi-writer.LICENSE** — MIT license for Hanzi Writer.
- **ARPHIC-LICENSE.txt** — license/attribution for the Make Me a Hanzi stroke data used by `src/data/stroke-data.js`.
- Stroke outlines and medians come from https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi, which is derived from Arphic fonts.

The app bundles only 16 characters, not the full 9,000-character dataset.
